literature.title: Enteral lorazepam is a promising weaning strategy for midazolam-responsive febrile infection-related epilepsy syndrome (FIRES): a case series.
literature.journal: Epileptic disorders : international epilepsy journal with videotape
literature.abstract: Prolonged and repetitive cycles of pharmacological coma, with midazolam or other general anaesthetics, is often the mainstay for seizure control in febrile infection-related epilepsy syndrome (FIRES). Here we present our experience of enteral lorazepam as an effective weaning substitute in midazolam-dependent patients.

literature.title: Potential Role of Perampanel in Reducing Barbiturate Dependency in Febrile Infection-Related Epilepsy Syndrome: A Case Report.
literature.abstract: Febrile infection-related epilepsy syndrome (FIRES) is a type of new-onset refractory status epilepticus (NORSE) that occurs in previously healthy children. Conventional antiepileptic drugs (AEDs) often fail to control seizures, necessitating the use of high-dose anesthetics, which can lead to severe complications and poor outcomes. Perampanel has shown promise in the treatment of refractory epilepsy; however, its role in FIRES remains underexplored. We report the case of a 13-year-old boy with

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: FIRES 為新發難治性癲癇持續狀態，目前以高劑量鎮靜藥物（midazolam、barbiturate）控制。Clobazam 作為 1,5-BZD，理論上可透過 GABA-A 增強提供口服替代選擇，用於脫離靜脈鎮靜劑。PMID 39958143 直接呈現一例 13 歲 FIRES 患者，經 perampanel 脫離 thiopental 後，最終以 clobazam + levetiracetam 達無發作狀態。
Perioral myoclonia with absences 為廣泛性癲癇症候群，以 3Hz 棘慢複合波及口周肌陣攣為特徵。苯二氮平類藥物（含 clobazam）對廣泛性發作有 GABA-A 理論基礎，但缺乏任何臨床文獻支持 clobazam 於此特定症候群之應用。TxGNN 高分（0.998）反映知識圖譜預測，非臨床驗證。
隱源性晚發性癲癇性痙攣（>18 個月）通常對 ACTH/vigabatrin 反應較差。Clobazam 對嬰兒痙攣缺乏直接臨床文獻，GABA-A 正向調控機轉雖合理，但此特定子型無任何發表數據支持。需注意 BZD 類藥物在嬰兒癲癇之鎮靜副作用風險。

literature.abstract: Reflex epilepsy (RE) is characterised by seizures that are regularly elicited by some specific stimulus or event mediated by neural pathways. In a prospective study of 1287 epileptic patients seen at Peradeniya, 223 (17.3%) were found to have RE, eating being the commonest stimulus (191 patients, 85.7%). literature.title: Summary of recommendations for the management of infantile seizures: Task Force Report for the ILAE Commission of Pediatrics.
literature.abstract: Evidence-based guidelines, or recommendations, for the management of infants with seizures are lacking. A Task Force of the Commission of Pediatrics developed a consensus document addressing diagnostic markers, management interventions, and outcome measures for infants with seizures. predicted_indications.disease_name: early-onset epileptic encephalopathy and intellectual disability due to GRIN2A mutation

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: GRIN2A 編碼 NMDA 受體 GluN2A 次單元，功能增益突變導致谷氨酸過度活化。Clobazam 靶向 GABA-A 受體，與 NMDA 機轉截然不同，兩者交互作用僅為間接（GABA/谷氨酸系統平衡）。此罕見基因型癲癇性腦病無任何 clobazam 相關發表文獻，機轉連結薄弱。
不寧腿症候群主要涉及多巴胺功能障礙與鐵代謝，一線治療為多巴胺促效劑、gabapentinoids。雖有報告指 clonazepam（1,4-BZD）可改善 RLS 症狀，但 clobazam（1,5-BZD）在 RLS 幾乎無發表文獻。機轉連結不明確，且鎮靜副作用可能干擾症狀評估。此預測高分可能反映 KG 對 BZD 類藥物的廣泛關聯，非特異性臨床信號。
多微腦迴合併視神經發育不全為腦結構畸形，繼發性癲癇常見。Clobazam 可用於症狀性（結構性）癲癇之症狀控制，但對底層結構病因無療效。此疾病定義不含特異性神經化學靶點，clobazam 之應用僅屬非特異性對症治療，與「再利用」概念（針對新適應症之疾病修飾效果）有所偏差。無任何發表文獻。
